msgid: You get points for precious wares in your warehouses. The player with the highest score after %s wins the game.

note: TRANSLATORS: Will be inserted into "The player with the highest score after | %s wins the game." | TRANSLATORS: Will be inserted into "The winner will be the player […] with | the most territory after %s" | TRANSLATORS: Will be inserted into "The game will end after %s."

msgid: The tribe or team that can defeat all others wins the game! This means the opponents do not have any headquarters, ports or warehouses left.
The tribe or team that can find and destroy all other headquarters wins the game! Does not work with starting conditions without headquarters.

Each player or team tries to obtain more than half of the map’s area. The winner will be the player or the team that is able to keep that area for at least 20 minutes, or the one with the most territory after %s, whichever comes first. If the peaceful mode is selected, the game ends if one player has more land than any other player could gain.

As wood gnome you like big forests, so your task is to have more trees on your territory than any other player. The game will end after %s. The one with the most trees at that point will win the game.
